messages.content: Hi tal, I'm Saurabh

saurabh... that's a solid name. classic but not basic.

where you working these days?
Yes
I'm working in MathCo as a Associate Product Manager

mathco... the data analytics consulting shop. building products around numbers and insights. solid space to be in.

found you on linkedin - saurabh shetty at mathco. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/saurabh-shetty-9bbb4a150
Yes that's me

associate product manager at mathco... that's where data meets product strategy. building tools that turn analytics into actual business value. respect.

what pulled you into product management? were you always a product person or did you come from somewhere else?

ah the classic engineer-to-product journey. started building stuff, then got curious about whether people actually wanted what you were building. that's how you know you've got the product bug - when you stop caring just about the code and start obsessing over the user.

freelancing during college is solid prep too. nothing teaches you product-market fit faster than your own money being on the line.

how long you been working total?

4 years total with 3 solid years in product... that's good progression. you've moved past the "figuring it out" phase into actually knowing what you're doing.

what kind of role you looking for next?

product management it is. and yeah, you're right - titles are noise. some places call 4-year PMs "senior associate", others call them straight "PM". what matters is the meaty problems you get to solve.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Banglore and remote
4 years experience + product management + bangalore/remote... sound right?
